decision: Authorize regenerating the cross-language contract projections with their own generator packages/contracts/codegen/generate.py --write, and supersede the two U01-0001 product pins this necessarily moves: web/src/generated/contract-manifest.json and web/src/generated/contracts.ts. U01-0001 remains sealed and unmodified. This authorization covers only the seven files the generator owns; it does not authorize deleting web/src/generated/ui-client/index.d.ts, index.mjs or route-manifest.json, which the generator removed as unrecognized and which were restored byte-identically from their git blobs.
rationale: An independent review found that the schema amendments made under HD-EF4-INTEGRITY-SCOPE-20260802-001 left five shipped cross-language artifacts embedding the pre-amendment source digest sha256:19e12fe0affb, and that two of them were sealed-pinned and therefore passed the byte-comparison gate while asserting a projection of a tree that no longer exists. The repository's own generator confirmed the staleness independently: --check reported seven stale generated files before the regeneration and zero after. Leaving them stale would reproduce, one layer out, exactly the dependent-projection failure the invalidation registry was built to close. The generator is the declared authority for these files, so regenerating is preferred over hand-editing or over widening a waiver to cover stale output.
